[SWS_UCM_00237] RevertProcessedSwPackages OperationNotPer- mitted
⌈
RevertProcessedSwPackages method call shall raise the error Applica-
tionError OperationNotPermitted in case the processed Software Pack-
ages are successfully activated or it is called at other states than kReady (Soft-
ware Package(s) are finished being processed) or kProcessing states.
⌋
